scenes.title: Itineraries, quotes and suppliers
scenes.subtitle: Priced day by day, sent in a click
scenes.narration: Building the trip is where agencies spend their time. TravelCRM Pro makes the quote quick and keeps your margins in view.
Every itinerary and quote in one list, with its status, travel dates and value.
Build the trip day by day. Add a hotel straight from your supplier rate cards, and the cost and selling price fill themselves in.
Managers see cost, price and margin for every item, and each saved change keeps a version you can go back to.
Share the quote as a branded PDF or a private link the customer opens on their phone, and send it on WhatsApp or email through the communication hub.

callout.label: A link the customer can open

scenes.narration: Same trip for another family? Clone it and change only what is different.
Templates are your best-selling packages. Preview one, pick the lead, and it becomes a priced itinerary in one click.
Set your standard terms, inclusions and exclusions once, and every new quote starts with them.
Rate cards hold your negotiated supplier prices by season. Add one, and it is ready to use in the next quote.
The supplier directory keeps hotels, transport and activity partners, with their rates, what you have paid them, and a rating so the best ones are marked preferred.
Compare supplier rates side by side for a destination before you choose.

scenes.headline: Quotes in minutes, margins in view.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. Quotes in minutes, with your margins in view.
